<PAGE><|det|>header [114, 115, 293, 136]<|/det|>Bug ID #2 [Fixed]
<|det|>title [113, 170, 728, 192]<|/det|>Missing handling of fees on transfer in ERC20 token transfers
<|det|>title [113, 232, 262, 249]<|/det|>Vulnerability Type
<|det|>text [114, 251, 296, 268]<|/det|>Calculation Inaccuracy
<|det|>title [113, 290, 186, 306]<|/det|>Severity
<|det|>text [114, 309, 182, 325]<|/det|>Medium
<|det|>title [113, 348, 212, 364]<|/det|>Description
<|det|>text [112, 366, 886, 459]<|/det|>The contract contains a vulnerability related to transferring ERC20 tokens without considering the possibility of fees charged on transfer. Some ERC20 tokens implement a fee mechanism, where a certain percentage of tokens is deducted as a fee during each transfer. However, the contract does not account for this possibility when transferring tokens using the safeTransferFrom/TransferFrom function.
<|det|>title [113, 482, 234, 497]<|/det|>Affected Code
<|det|>text [142, 501, 880, 537]<|/det|>- https://github.com/hemilabs/vusd-stablecoin/blob/54f9f235f26df813152b3d3235e7f4373c e473b6/contracts/Minter.sol#L237-L249
<|det|>title [113, 559, 185, 574]<|/det|>Impacts
<|det|>text [112, 578, 886, 670]<|/det|>Failure to account for transfer fees can lead to accounting errors and financial losses. When tokens with transfer fees are transferred, the actual received amount may be less than expected due to the deduction of fees. As a result, the contract's internal accounting and balance tracking may become inaccurate, leading to discrepancies in token balances and potential financial losses for users.
<|det|>title [113, 693, 219, 707]<|/det|>Remediation
<|det|>text [112, 712, 884, 748]<|/det|>To address this vulnerability, it is recommended to add a mechanism to calculate the balance of the contract before and after the transfer is completed.
<|det|>title [113, 770, 174, 784]<|/det|>Retest
<|det|>text [113, 789, 316, 805]<|/det|>This issue has been fixed.
